methodology.UserFees: Interest and fees paid by borrowers when taking loans from Maple pools. This includes net interest on both traditional loan manager contracts and open-term loans.
methodology.Fees: Total interest and fees paid by borrowers on loans, including net interest from loan distributions and open-term loan claims.
methodology.Revenue: Total revenue flowing to Maple protocol treasuries, including fees from loan management, delegate fees, and platform fees collected from various pool strategies.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Total revenue flowing to Maple protocol treasuries.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Interest earned by liquidity providers/depositors in Maple pools from net interest distributions on loans.
